chat.author: David Benjamin
chat.text:
Dennis Jackson said:

We have sig_algs for multiple certs.

This is also well-trod and does not work. But do you want to try to fix sig_algs? I just presented one of the many things you would need to do here. As I said on the slides, sig_algs is pretty broken. It is a design flaw that it fundamentally requires the certificate dispatcher to know about the X.509 algorithm to TLS codepoint mapping. There seemed pretty clear consensus for the first option, but if you want the second option...
